_comment: Gaussian noise on the Gazebo IMU sensor (1 kHz, before ArduPilot's filters), per axis x y z of the sensor. Chosen so the IMU signal ArduPilot logs in hover has the same RMS as the real aircraft in the 20-150 Hz band (analysis/imu_noise.py). First guess: band RMS ~ 0.126 * stddev for a 20 Hz 2nd-order gyro/accel filter.
